idea-plugin.name: Code Line Tracker
idea-plugin.description:
Code Line Tracker gives you real-time visibility into your coding activity, right in the status bar. Ever wondered how many lines you actually write, refactor, or delete in a session? Now you can see it at a glance.

Features

  • Live Line Counter — See +added and -deleted lines updating in real-time as you code
  • Commit Mode — Automatically activates when you open the Commit panel, showing VCS diff stats for your staged changes
  • Per-File Breakdown — Click the widget to see detailed stats for each file you have touched
  • File Selection — Select specific files in the popup to see aggregated stats, with Select All / None shortcuts
  • Sort Toggle — Switch between alphabetical (A-Z) and most-changed-first sorting
  • Commit Selected — Exclude files from commit directly from the popup, then press Commit Selected to open the Commit panel with only your chosen files
  • Changes Tab Decoration — Each changelist shows its own diff totals based on the files it contains
  • Line Limit — Set a per-commit line limit (default 500); the status bar turns green, yellow or red as you approach it
  • Commit Check — Get a confirmation dialog before committing more lines than your limit
  • Fit to Limit — One click picks the files that fit within the limit, so large changes are easy to split. Related files, such as a class and its test, stay together
  • Branch View — See the total size of your branch compared with main, roughly what your pull request will contain
  • Ignore Patterns — Lock files, minified and generated files are left out of the counts (configurable)

Why Use It?

  • Track your daily coding output for standups and reports
  • Prove your productivity — especially useful when your company tracks lines-per-commit metrics
  • Get a quick overview before committing: how big is this change?
  • Keep commits small and reviewable — especially useful when your team has a lines-per-commit limit
  • Zero configuration — install and it just works; tune it under Settings → Tools → Code Line Tracker

How It Works

  1. Session Mode — Tracks every edit in real-time using git diff
  2. Commit Mode — Auto-switches when the Commit panel opens, calculates actual VCS diffs for staged files
  3. Click the widget in the status bar for the full per-file breakdown
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.6 — Commit Line Limit

  • Cleaner popup — Changes and Branch tabs, one progress bar for the limit, a single select-all checkbox, and a commit button that shows how many files and lines you are about to commit
  • Compact status bar — Shows 575 / 500 with a colored dot; added and deleted lines are in the tooltip
  • Line limit — Set a per-commit limit in Settings → Tools → Code Line Tracker (default 500). The status bar shows a green, yellow or red dot as you approach and pass it
  • Commit check — Committing more lines than the limit asks for confirmation first
  • Fit to limit — When you are over the limit, one click in the popup selects the files that fit, so you can split the change into smaller commits. Related files (a class and its test, a component and its styles) are never split apart
  • Commit tab sync — Checking or unchecking files in the popup now also checks or unchecks them in the Commit tool window
  • Branch view — Click "Branch ▸" in the popup to see how big your branch is compared with main, including uncommitted work. Optionally set a pull request line limit in Settings
  • Ignore patterns — Lock files, minified files, source maps, snapshots and generated code are no longer counted. Edit the list in Settings

1.1.35 — Code Completion Fix

  • Fixed: code completion popup was closed a few seconds after it appeared while typing — the plugin no longer auto-saves files to count lines
  • Fixed: details popup no longer covers the status bar

1.1.34 — IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 Support

  • Compatible with IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 (build 262) — the plugin is no longer reported as incompatible after upgrading

1.1.33 — Stability & Performance

  • Plugin no longer slows you down when multiple projects are open at the same time
  • Works smoothly with the latest IntelliJ versions (no deprecated API warnings)
  • Less background noise — only changed files trigger refreshes, not every keystroke in every project
  • Cleaner project shutdown — no leftover background tasks when you close a project
  • Smoother experience in the Commit panel — fewer hiccups when checking/unchecking files
  • Clearer sort toggle button (A-Z ▾ / Most Changed ▾) — shows the current order instead of the next one
  • More reliable git diff handling, with clearer error messages in the IDE log if something goes wrong

1.1.31 — Sort Toggle, Select All / None

  • Sort toggle — Click "Most Changed" or "A-Z" to switch between alphabetical and most-changed-first sorting
  • Select All / None — Quickly select or deselect all files in the popup
  • Files are sorted alphabetically (A-Z) by default

1.1.29 — Per-Changelist Diff Stats

  • Each changelist folder now shows its own diff totals based on the files it contains
  • The "[CLT] Temporarily Excluded from Commit" folder shows excluded files' totals separately

1.1.25 — Real-Time Commit Selection

  • Instant changelist sync — Unchecking a file in the popup immediately moves it to the excluded changelist; checking it moves it back to Changes
  • Commit Selected button — Opens the Commit panel with only your selected files ready to commit
  • New display format: Total : XX || +N -N
  • Excluded changelist renamed to "[CLT] Temporarily Excluded from Commit" for clarity
  • Excluded files are automatically restored when the Commit panel closes or the plugin is disposed

1.1.22 — Commit Mode Fix & Total Counter

  • Commit Mode now works correctly — Switched from git diff --cached to git diff HEAD since IntelliJ does not stage files until commit
  • Added total line count (added + deleted) to status bar, popup, and Changes tab decorator

1.1.20 — Accurate Real-Time Tracking

  • Bug fix: Files are now saved to disk before running git diff — previously, in-memory edits were not detected
  • Bug fix: Added DocumentListener with 1.5s debounce for real-time change detection on every edit
  • Bug fix: Removed unversioned/untracked files from diff output — only tracked files are shown

1.1.18 — Git Diff Engine Rewrite

  • Bug fix: Separated stderr from stdout to prevent git warnings from corrupting diff output
  • Bug fix: Removed strict .git directory check — plugin now works in subdirectories of git repos
  • Bug fix: Added 10-second timeout to prevent process hangs
  • Added --no-renames flag for accurate per-file line counts
  • Fallback for repos with no HEAD commit
